replication.target_description: Published replication of Stahlberg et al. (2001), Study 2; percentage of women listed under masculine generics versus gender-inclusive forms. Page 7 gives both the one-factorial linguistic-expression ANOVA and the two-factorial ANOVA including participant gender, with distinct analytic samples. The neutral locator does not uniquely distinguish these tests.

n.sample_role: Candidate analytic participants: 344 in the one-factorial ANOVA; 340 in analyses involving participant gender. No target-specific N selected.
n.exclusions: Source p.5: 400 recruited; 3 incomplete, 27 guessed purpose, 5 rewrote instructions, 1 misunderstood instructions, and 20 capital-I participants exclusively named women were excluded, leaving 344. Two did not disclose gender and two did not identify with binary gender; analyses involving participant gender exclude these four, leaving 340.
